description: EXP-34 pilot. Redo of EXP-23 narrow-then-widen, slim 2 arms (baseline_narrow_then_wide vs wide_only), NL only for the staged pilot. Step 1 runs nl_pilot10 (10% of the full 192 arm-pair design); analyse for obvious breakage; if healthy, questions_from is expanded to nl_pilot24 (25%) and the spec re-run (idempotent resume). One variable: search_strategy. Nothing to resume from EXP-23: those 58 rows are Opus 4.6 under a different experiment_id.
